contract.title: Risk-Adaptive Accuracy Gate
contract.frozen_contract: Evidence is required before completion. Risk determines a cumulative verification ladder: LOW targeted test/typecheck/diff sanity; MEDIUM relevant tests, Requirement Ledger, affected-file review, simplification check; HIGH adds RepoWise impact context, fresh independent Intent Verifier, negative/adversarial tests, and rollback; CRITICAL adds explicit approval for irreversible actions and optional second independent verification. A material requirement remaining unverified blocks normal completion.
contract.automated_evidence_required: Risk selection, exact cumulative ladder expansion, action-state binding, material requirement blocking, approval semantics, deterministic bounded output, CLI exposure, and P3.6 coupling tests.
contract.live_runtime_proof_required: Current OMP-primary must select and enforce LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL ladders, block missing evidence, couple completion_allowed to P3.6 STOP, preserve parent/worker identities, and report measured overhead.
contract.token_economic_objective: Prevent invalid iterations while preserving completion reserve; measure gate bookkeeping, verification calls/tokens, retries/corrections, and blocked completion overhead rather than claiming hypothetical savings.
contract.dogfood_requirement: Real OMP-primary risk-level probes, negative controls, parent/worker path, and the P3.7 implementation/proof task itself must pass through the gate before P3.6 finalization.
contract.acceptance_promotion_gates: Automated ladder/gate contract, four risk-level runtime cases, negative controls, P3.6 STOP coupling, parent/worker evidence, economics, dogfood, and fresh independent Validator proof; P3.8 untouched.
